description: Bilingual strings of the ArkDeck App surfaces the Windows client shows (TASK-XPA-007). An entry with a table is the macOS App's entry of the same key in ArkDeckApp/Resources/<table>.xcstrings, values unchanged; an entry whose table is null exists on Windows only (a Windows surface with no macOS counterpart, such as the daemon-unavailable recovery banner). windows/scripts/generate-ui-strings.py writes the Windows .resw files from this file and keeps the .xcstrings entries equal to it; --check fails on any drift.

entries.en: Adoption (durable binding) is performed from the CLI: arkdeck device adopt. This App does not submit adoption.
entries.zh-Hans: 接管（建立持久绑定）由 CLI 执行：arkdeck device adopt。本 App 不提交接管操作。

entries.en: Nothing needs attention in the current diagnostics.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前诊断中没有需要处理的事项。

entries.en: Runtime history could not be read
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取 Runtime 记录

entries.en: No recent runs yet. Start from a workflow in the sidebar.
entries.zh-Hans: 还没有最近运行，请从左侧工作流开始。
正在加载 Runtime 历史
无法读取 Runtime 历史

entries.en: Start or reconnect ArkDeck Runtime, then refresh the history.
entries.zh-Hans: 请启动或重新连接 ArkDeck Runtime，然后刷新历史记录。

entries.en: ArkDeck Runtime has recorded no Jobs on this host.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck Runtime 在本机尚未记录任何 Job。

entries.en: History only reads Runtime state. Opening a related tool never submits, cancels, or retries this Job.
entries.zh-Hans: History 只读取 Runtime 状态。打开相关工具不会提交、取消或重试此 Job。
正从已确认安全边界恢复

entries.en: Start or reconnect ArkDeck Runtime, then refresh jobs.
entries.zh-Hans: 启动或重新连接 ArkDeck Runtime，然后刷新 Job。

entries.en: Runtime is reachable and has no recorded jobs.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 可访问，但尚未记录任何 Job。

entries.en: The device effect is unknown. Do not treat this Job as finished.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备影响未知。不要把此 Job 视为已经完成。

entries.en: Runtime stopped at a human-required boundary.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已停在需要人工处理的边界。

entries.en: Enter 1–64 characters. This name is shown only in ArkDeck; it does not change the device identity or binding.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入 1–64 个字符。此名称仅用于 ArkDeck 中显示，不会修改设备标识或绑定关系。

entries.en: Select a Job to inspect its details. The planned / simulated marker stays with a job permanently, in History and in any export.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个 Job 以查看详情。planned / simulated 标识永久跟随 Job，包括历史与导出。
正在加载 Job 详情

entries.en: Outcome unknown — this Job's effect on the device was never confirmed.
entries.zh-Hans: 结果未知——此 Job 对设备的影响从未被确认。

entries.en: Waiting for a person to act.
No Artifacts were recorded for this Job.
entries.zh-Hans: 此 Job 未记录 Artifact。

entries.en: No captured artifacts: a planned job carries only its plan record, by design.
entries.zh-Hans: 无采集产物：planned Job 按设计只含计划记录。

entries.en: Artifact bytes are read in bounded verified chunks. The selected destination stays in the App and is never sent to Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: Artifact 字节通过有界分块读取并校验；所选保存位置仅留在 App 内，不会发送给 Runtime。
检查 Artifact 导出信息

entries.en: Customize ArkDeck and review build identity, platform information, and privacy guarantees.
entries.zh-Hans: 自定义 ArkDeck，并查看构建身份、平台信息与隐私保证。

entries.en: Session artifacts stay in the configured local storage root unless you explicitly export them.
entries.zh-Hans: 除非你主动导出，否则 Session 产物始终保存在已配置的本地存储目录。
不会自动上传诊断信息

entries.en: Crashes and Job failures never create or upload a diagnostic bundle automatically.
entries.zh-Hans: 崩溃或任务失败都不会自动生成或上传诊断包。

entries.en: Inspect the selected HDC executable and its verified server context.
entries.zh-Hans: 检查当前选中的 HDC 可执行文件及其已验证的服务端上下文。

entries.en: Manage the Session root, quota and retention window, and read what each store is actually holding.
entries.zh-Hans: 管理 Session 根目录、配额与保留周期，并查看每个存储实际占用了多少。

entries.en: These are the bytes ArkDeck Runtime stores for Jobs. Runtime measures and enforces this quota itself; the policy above applies to the Session output root instead.
entries.zh-Hans: 这里是 ArkDeck Runtime 为任务保存的 Artifact 字节。该配额由 Runtime 自行计量与执行；上方的策略作用于 Session 输出根，不作用于这里。

entries.en: ArkDeck Runtime did not report its artifact usage, so no figure is shown here.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck Runtime 未报告 Artifact 用量，因此这里不显示数字。

entries.en: The quota, safety margin and retention window above apply to this root only. Runtime artifacts are stored separately and are not counted here.
entries.zh-Hans: 上方的配额、安全余量与保留周期只作用于这个根目录。Runtime Artifact 单独存放，不计入这里。

entries.en: Retention cleanup never deletes pinned Sessions.
entries.zh-Hans: 保留策略清理绝不会删除已固定的 Session。

entries.en: Current usage is unavailable. The saved quota and retention policy remain visible above.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前用量不可用；已保存的配额与保留策略仍显示在上方。

entries.en: Cancellation requested. Runtime is reaching a safe boundary; wait for its terminal state.
entries.zh-Hans: 已请求取消。Runtime 正在到达安全边界，请等待最终状态。

entries.en: Cancellation was not confirmed. Refresh the record before trying again.
entries.zh-Hans: 取消请求未确认。请刷新记录后重试。

entries.en: Review the recorded reason and evidence before continuing through an approved Runtime path.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先检查已记录的原因和证据，再通过已批准的 Runtime 路径继续。

entries.en: Choose the entry HAP first. Add up to 16 feature HAPs or HSPs from the same bundle; all packages are installed together. Each file must be 1 byte–64 MiB.
entries.zh-Hans: 先选择入口 HAP，再添加同一 Bundle 的 feature HAP 或 HSP，最多 16 个，所有包一起安装。每个文件为 1 字节至 64 MiB。

entries.en: Capture bounded HiLog while the app runs
entries.zh-Hans: 应用运行时采集有界 HiLog

entries.en: Names are validated against the Catalog schema; they are never interpreted as arguments.
entries.zh-Hans: 名称按 Catalog schema 校验，绝不会被解释为命令参数。
正在校验并导入安装包…

entries.en: The current target probe returned no package names.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前目标探测未返回应用包名。

entries.en: The App checks and imports every package in bounded chunks before submitting one Job. Local paths never cross into Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: App 会先逐个校验并分块导入所有安装包，再提交一个 Job。本地路径不会进入 Runtime。

entries.en: Install, start, stop, uninstall, and remote staging are device mutations. Every dispatch must bind the durable target revision and consume matching authority.
entries.zh-Hans: 安装、启动、停止、卸载与远端暂存均为设备变更。每次 dispatch 必须绑定持久设备 revision 并消费匹配授权。
设备变更影响范围明确可见

entries.en: Runtime is executing the typed HAP lifecycle…
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 正在执行 typed HAP 生命周期…

entries.en: Uninstall after run removes the app, so it cannot stay running. Choose Retain installed app to keep observing it.
entries.zh-Hans: 运行后卸载会移除应用，无法保持运行。要继续观察应用，请选择“保留已安装应用”。

entries.en: Each package can be selected only once. Remove the duplicate selection.
entries.zh-Hans: 同一个安装包只能选择一次，请移除重复选择。

entries.en: The selected file could not be read.

entries.zh-Hans: 请选择一个 .hap 入口包。

entries.en: Choose .hap or .hsp files with basenames containing letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择 .hap 或 .hsp 文件，文件名仅含字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。

entries.en: Choose one entry .hap. Use a basename with letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
entries.zh-Hans: 请选择一个 .hap 入口包，文件名仅含字母、数字、点、下划线或连字符。
附加安装包最多可选 16 个。

entries.en: Read from the signed ELF during validation
entries.zh-Hans: 校验时从已签名 ELF 自动读取

entries.en: Use a dotted bundle name such as com.example.app.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入 com.example.app 形式的 Bundle 名称。

entries.en: Name the owning app and library. Runtime derives the app-owned device destination from the published profile; this page never accepts a remote path.
entries.zh-Hans: 填写所属应用与动态库名称。Runtime 根据已发布 profile 推导 app-owned 设备目标位置；此页面不接受远端路径。

entries.en: Use a lib<name>.so filename with no directory components.
entries.zh-Hans: 请输入不含目录的 lib<name>.so 文件名。

entries.en: Deployment did not reach verified completion
entries.zh-Hans: 部署未达到验证完成状态

entries.en: Runtime plan is ready for review
The Native Debug path always verifies the published hash, restarted process, and loaded-library maps. Any failed verification automatically restores and re-verifies the previous library.
entries.zh-Hans: Native Debug 路径始终验证发布 hash、重启后的进程与动态库加载 maps；任一验证失败都会自动恢复并复验旧动态库。

entries.en: Validating the signed ELF and materializing the Runtime plan…
entries.zh-Hans: 正在校验已签名 ELF 并生成 Runtime 计划…

entries.en: Production supports one signed app-owned .so per request from either a local file or a verified read-only SSH build source. Every request still passes ELF/ABI/Build ID/hash validation, backup, atomic publish, Ability restart, loaded-library readback, and rollback on failure. SMB, WSL, batches, .abc replacement, and standalone device restart remain unavailable until published as typed behavior.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前生产能力每次支持一个本地文件或已验证只读 SSH 构建源中的已签名 app-owned .so；两种来源都执行 ELF / ABI / Build ID / hash 校验、备份、原子发布、Ability 重启、加载 readback 与失败回滚。SMB、WSL、批量、.abc 替换和独立设备重启在对应 typed behavior 发布前保持不可用。

entries.en: The artifact was selected, but its server could not be bound to this target.
entries.zh-Hans: 远端产物已选择，但无法把该服务器绑定到当前目标。

entries.en: Browse folders below the verified build root. Only lib*.so files are shown.
entries.zh-Hans: 浏览已验证编译根目录以内的文件夹；这里只显示 lib*.so 文件。

entries.en: Add and verify an SSH server in Settings > Servers first.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先在“设置 > 服务器”中添加并验证 SSH 服务器。

entries.en: No folders or native libraries here
entries.zh-Hans: 此处没有文件夹或动态库

entries.en: Validation must complete before the plan can be submitted. The reviewed plan digest pins the exact target, binding, Artifact lease, inputs, and step sequence.
entries.zh-Hans: 校验完成后才能提交计划。已检查的 plan digest 会固定精确 target、binding、Artifact lease、输入和步骤序列。

entries.en: Restore and verify the previous library on failure
entries.zh-Hans: 失败时恢复并复验旧动态库

entries.en: Runtime is deploying and verifying the library
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 正在部署并验证动态库

entries.en: Waiting for the next durable Runtime stage.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在等待下一个持久化 Runtime 阶段。

entries.en: Back up, replace, restart, and verify

ABI and signature validation block incompatible input before device writes. Runtime backs up the current library, publishes atomically, restarts the owning Ability, and requires loaded-library maps. Any failed verification automatically restores and re-verifies the previous library.
entries.zh-Hans: ABI 与签名校验会在设备写入前阻止不兼容输入。Runtime 随后备份当前动态库、原子发布、重启所属 Ability，并要求动态库加载 maps；任一验证失败都会自动恢复并复验旧动态库。

entries.en: Choose one signed app-owned native library from a local output or a verified remote build source. Only the selected bytes enter the controlled Artifact import channel.
entries.zh-Hans: 从本地输出或已验证的远端构建源中选择一个已签名的 app-owned 动态库；只有所选文件字节会进入受控 Artifact 导入通道。

entries.en: SSH sources are read-only, host-key pinned, and confined to the saved canonical build root. SMB, WSL, batch selection, and .abc search remain unavailable.
entries.zh-Hans: SSH 构建源为只读能力，固定主机密钥并限制在已保存的真实编译根目录内。SMB、WSL、批量选择与 .abc 搜索仍未开放。

entries.en: Library published, Ability restarted, and loaded state verified
entries.zh-Hans: 动态库已发布，Ability 已重启，加载状态已验证

entries.en: Verify hash, process, and loaded maps
entries.zh-Hans: 验证 hash、进程与已加载 maps
正在检查 Runtime 可用性…

entries.en: The operation descriptor is missing from this build. Nothing can be prepared.
entries.zh-Hans: 此构建缺少 operation descriptor，无法准备任何请求。

entries.en: No published Runtime operation exposes device buffer mutation. Normal capture never clears, resizes, or flushes it.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前没有已发布 Runtime operation 提供设备 buffer 变更；普通采集绝不会清空、扩容或 flush。

entries.en: No published Runtime operation starts, stops, or uninstalls an individual package. Use the typed HAP lifecycle above.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前没有已发布 Runtime operation 可以启动、停止或卸载单个应用；请使用上方的 typed HAP 生命周期。

entries.en: Only the provider may lower this typed input into executable + argv after Runtime admission. The Job's derived report discloses that lowering; the UI never guesses or concatenates a shell command.
entries.zh-Hans: 只有 provider 可在 Runtime 准入后将此 typed input 降级为 executable + argv。Job 的派生报告会披露 lowering；UI 不猜测也不拼接 shell 命令。
没有已发布的模板 Artifact

entries.en: Run an approved template to publish its bounded output and report.
entries.zh-Hans: 运行 approved 模板后，Runtime 会发布有界输出与报告。

entries.en: The App submits approved typed templates only through debug.template@1. Runtime records the request as a durable Job and publishes bounded Artifacts.
entries.zh-Hans: App 只通过 debug.template@1 提交 approved typed template。Runtime 会把请求记录为持久 Job，并发布有界 Artifact。

entries.en: There is no free-text command, argv or path field; PTY and raw shell do not belong to this surface.
entries.zh-Hans: 不存在自由文本 command / argv / path 字段；PTY 与 raw shell 不属于此界面。
Debug 模板 Job 正在运行

entries.en: No PTY, password prompt, sudo, or interactive session
entries.zh-Hans: 不提供 PTY、密码提示、sudo 或交互会话

entries.en: This template declares no user parameters.
Runtime could not finalize all artifacts. Review the Job details.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 无法完成全部 Artifact。请检查 Job 详情。

entries.en: Runtime could not publish an execution artifact. Review the Job details.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 无法发布执行 Artifact。请检查 Job 详情。

entries.en: The operation stopped at a safe boundary.
entries.zh-Hans: 操作已在安全边界停止。

entries.en: The operation did not run. Runtime proof is required before another request.
entries.zh-Hans: 操作未执行。提交另一个请求前必须取得 Runtime 证明。

entries.en: Execution failed. Review this Job’s artifacts and diagnostics.
entries.zh-Hans: 执行失败。请检查此 Job 的 Artifact 和诊断信息。

entries.en: Runtime was interrupted. Review the Job before continuing.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已中断。继续前请检查此 Job。

entries.en: The operation failed. Review the Job timeline and artifacts.
entries.zh-Hans: 操作失败。请检查 Job timeline 和 Artifact。

entries.en: The device effect is unknown. Keep the device unchanged while Runtime reconciles it.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备影响未知。Runtime 核对期间请保持设备状态不变。

entries.en: Runtime confirmed that the operation did not complete. Submit another typed request only after Runtime permits it.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 已确认操作未完成。仅在 Runtime 允许后提交新的 typed 请求。

entries.en: These actions modify global device logging state and require separate capability checks, confirmation, and audit.
entries.zh-Hans: 这些操作会修改设备全局日志状态，必须单独进行能力检查、确认与审计。

entries.en: Artifact bytes are read in bounded verified chunks; the save location is handled only by the App and is never sent to Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: Artifact 字节通过有界分块读取并校验；保存位置只由 App 处理，不会发送给 Runtime。
检查 Artifact 导出信息

entries.en: Invalid typed value in: %@. Use letters, numbers, dot, underscore, colon, or hyphen only.
entries.zh-Hans: 以下 typed 值无效：%@。仅可使用字母、数字、点、下划线、冒号或连字符。

entries.en: Every filter is a bounded typed token. Free shell fragments are never accepted.
entries.zh-Hans: 每项筛选都是有界 typed token，不接受任何自由 shell 片段。

entries.en: A Runtime capture can publish bounded shards and a manifest. Pausing this viewport would never stop host capture.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 采集可发布有界分片与 manifest；暂停此视图绝不会停止 host 采集。

entries.en: The viewport can pause only while a capture is running; pausing never stops host capture.
entries.zh-Hans: 仅在采集进行中才能暂停界面；暂停绝不停止 host 采集。
保存 raw HiLog Artifact（必需）

entries.en: Completed shards appear here in manifest order with exact size and hash.
entries.zh-Hans: 已完成分片将按 manifest 顺序显示精确大小与 hash。
已发布 operation 总输出预算：%@

entries.en: Deletion must name the exact rule and durable target binding
entries.zh-Hans: 删除必须明确指定规则与持久目标设备 binding

entries.en: The current Runtime publishes no operation for reading forward/reverse rules.
entries.zh-Hans: 当前 Runtime 未发布读取 forward/reverse 规则的 operation。

entries.en: Every create/delete operation binds one durable target revision
entries.zh-Hans: 每个新建/删除操作绑定一个持久目标设备 revision

entries.en: No shell fragments, schemes, hosts, or flags are accepted
entries.zh-Hans: 不接受 shell 片段、scheme、host 或 flag

entries.en: Only decimal TCP ports from 1024 through 65535 are accepted
entries.zh-Hans: 仅接受 1024 到 65535 的十进制 TCP 端口
请输入十进制 Host 端口。

entries.en: Host port must be from 1024 through 65535.
entries.zh-Hans: Host 端口必须在 1024 到 65535 之间。
请输入十进制设备端口。

entries.en: Device port must be from 1024 through 65535.
entries.zh-Hans: 设备端口必须在 1024 到 65535 之间。

entries.en: Both ports are valid typed values.
entries.zh-Hans: 两个端口均为有效 typed 值。

entries.en: Typed Artifact deployment, logs, app lifecycle, network rules, and approved read-only tools — never a raw terminal.
entries.zh-Hans: Typed 产物部署、日志、应用生命周期、网络规则和 approved 只读工具——绝非 raw terminal。

entries.en: %@ accepts only letters, digits and . _ : - — the value never reaches a shell.
entries.zh-Hans: %@ 只接受字母、数字和 . _ : -；该值绝不会进入 shell。

entries.en: The local ArkDeck Runtime is not running or did not answer.
entries.zh-Hans: 本机的 ArkDeck Runtime 未运行或没有应答。

entries.en: The local endpoint is served by a process that is not the installed ArkDeck Runtime, so nothing was sent to it.
entries.zh-Hans: 本机端点由一个不是已安装 ArkDeck Runtime 的进程提供，因此没有向它发送任何内容。

entries.en: The running ArkDeck Runtime speaks another control contract than this app.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在运行的 ArkDeck Runtime 使用的控制契约与本 App 不同。

entries.en: This copy of ArkDeck has no installed ArkDeck Runtime identity to verify, so it did not connect.
entries.zh-Hans: 此 ArkDeck 副本没有可供校验的已安装 ArkDeck Runtime 身份，因此没有连接。

entries.en: Start the ArkDeck Runtime, then retry: any arkdeck command that needs it starts it, and arkdeck doctor shows what is wrong.
entries.zh-Hans: 请启动 ArkDeck Runtime 后重试：任何需要它的 arkdeck 命令都会启动它，arkdeck doctor 会说明问题所在。

entries.en: Quit whatever holds the endpoint, then start ArkDeck again; arkdeck doctor reports the held name.
entries.zh-Hans: 请退出占用该端点的程序，然后重新启动 ArkDeck；arkdeck doctor 会报告被占用的名称。

entries.en: Install matching ArkDeck app and Runtime versions, then start ArkDeck again.
entries.zh-Hans: 请安装版本匹配的 ArkDeck App 与 Runtime，然后重新启动 ArkDeck。

entries.en: Install ArkDeck with its Runtime, or set ARKDECK_DAEMON_PATH with ARKDECK_DAEMON_SIGNER_SHA256 or ARKDECK_DAEMON_PACKAGE_FAMILY, then retry.
entries.zh-Hans: 请安装带 Runtime 的 ArkDeck，或设置 ARKDECK_DAEMON_PATH 以及 ARKDECK_DAEMON_SIGNER_SHA256 或 ARKDECK_DAEMON_PACKAGE_FAMILY，然后重试。

entries.en: Runtime diagnostics could not be read
entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取 Runtime 诊断
%1$lld 个阻断 · %2$lld 个警告 · %3$lld 条信息

entries.en: Scripted daemon "%@": nothing on this window comes from ArkDeck Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: 脚本化 daemon “%@”：此窗口中的内容均不来自 ArkDeck Runtime。

entries.en: No device has been adopted yet.

entries.zh-Hans: 无法读取已接管的目标

entries.en: Select an adopted target to see its details.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个已接管的目标以查看详情。
接管时的 HDC 版本
在文件资源管理器中显示

entries.en: The Trace viewer is not available on Windows yet: the Runtime inspects the Trace, and Export… saves it for another tool.
entries.zh-Hans: Windows 版暂不提供 Trace 查看器：Trace 由 Runtime 检查，可用“导出…”保存后在其他工具中打开。

entries.en: What the ArkDeck Runtime reports about itself, and the CLI commands that control it.
entries.zh-Hans: ArkDeck Runtime 自身报告的信息，以及控制它的 CLI 命令。
已配置 · 已接管 %lld 台

entries.en: Status, verification and restart of the Runtime run in the CLI. The App only reads the Runtime through its authenticated pipe; it never starts, stops or replaces it.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 的状态、校验与重启在 CLI 中执行。App 只通过经过认证的管道读取 Runtime，从不启动、停止或替换它。

entries.en: Signing credentials are held by the Runtime in Windows Credential Manager and are never shown here; read their status with the CLI.
entries.zh-Hans: 签名凭据由 Runtime 保存在 Windows 凭据管理器中，此处从不显示；请用 CLI 查看其状态。
无法读取 HDC 状态

entries.en: The derived Trace cache the Runtime keeps; the original Traces are never cache entries.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 维护的 Trace 派生缓存；原始 Trace 从不属于缓存条目。
无法读取 Trace 缓存状态
%1$lld 个条目 · %2$lld 个活跃 · %3$lld 个非活跃

entries.en: Workspace projects and presets registered with the Runtime. Registering and changing them runs in the CLI; the project roots stay with the Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: 已向 Runtime 登记的工作区项目与预设。登记和修改在 CLI 中执行；项目根目录只由 Runtime 保存。

entries.en: Select a project to see its presets.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个项目以查看其预设。

entries.en: No preset is registered for this project.
The Sessions the Runtime keeps on this PC: pin the ones to keep, export one, or clean up what the retention policy allows.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 在这台电脑上保存的 Session：固定要保留的，导出某一个，或清理保留策略允许清理的。

entries.en: Select a Session to see it.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个 Session 以查看详情。

entries.en: Pinned: retention cleanup never removes it.
entries.zh-Hans: 已固定：保留清理不会移除它。

entries.en: Unpinned: retention cleanup may remove it when it expires.
entries.zh-Hans: 已取消固定：到期后保留清理可以移除它。
检查 Session 导出信息

entries.en: The Runtime writes Session %1$@ to the new folder %2$@ (about %3$@). Device identifiers: %4$@. Sensitive Artifacts are not included.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会把 Session %1$@ 写入新文件夹 %2$@（约 %3$@）。设备标识：%4$@。不包含敏感 Artifact。

entries.en: Removes %1$lld Sessions and reclaims %2$@ (from %3$@ to %4$@). Pinned Sessions are kept.
entries.zh-Hans: 将移除 %1$lld 个 Session，回收 %2$@（从 %3$@ 降至 %4$@）。已固定的 Session 会保留。

entries.en: Nothing to clean up: the retention policy keeps every Session.
entries.zh-Hans: 无需清理：保留策略会保留所有 Session。
已移除 %1$lld 个 Session，回收 %2$@。

entries.en: Runtime stops Job %@ at its next safe boundary. A step already writing to the device finishes first.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会在下一个安全边界停止 Job %@。已经在写设备的步骤会先完成。
%1$lld 个 Artifact，%2$lld 个已校验 · %3$lld 个清理项

entries.en: The agent executions the Runtime runs and the human actions they wait on. Starting an agent stays in the CLI.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 运行的 Agent 执行，以及它们正在等待的人工操作。启动 Agent 仍在 CLI 中进行。
无法读取 Agent 执行
当前没有等待中的人工操作。
当前没有 Agent 执行记录。

entries.en: Select an agent execution to see it.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个 Agent 执行以查看详情。

entries.en: The outcome is unknown: check the device before running it again.
entries.zh-Hans: 结果未知：再次运行前请先检查设备。

entries.en: Choose one of the listed values first.

entries.zh-Hans: 已继续：Runtime 会接着执行。
放弃这个 Agent 执行？

entries.en: The Runtime stops agent execution %1$@ (generation %2$@). It cannot be resumed afterwards.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会停止 Agent 执行 %1$@（代次 %2$@），之后不能再继续。

entries.en: The agent execution was not abandoned
Files uploaded to the Runtime and published as Artifacts for an adopted Target. Each file is checked, sent in verified chunks and published by the Runtime.
entries.zh-Hans: 上传到 Runtime、并作为某个已接管 Target 的 Artifact 发布的文件。每个文件都会先检查，再分块校验发送，最后由 Runtime 发布。

entries.en: No Target is adopted: adopt one in the CLI first.
entries.zh-Hans: 尚未接管任何 Target：请先在 CLI 中接管。

entries.en: Upload cancelled; the partial Import was aborted.
entries.zh-Hans: 已取消上传；未完成的导入已中止。

entries.en: Select an Import to see it.
entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个导入以查看详情。

entries.en: The Runtime releases Import %1$@ (generation %2$@). A Job can no longer use its Artifact.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 会释放导入 %1$@（代次 %2$@），之后 Job 不能再使用它的 Artifact。

entries.en: Remote build servers are configured in the macOS App's Settings; the Windows App has none yet. Choose a local library.
entries.zh-Hans: 远程构建服务器在 macOS App 的设置中配置；Windows App 暂无。请选择本地库。
请先选择一个已接管的 Target。

entries.en: Complete the fields above with valid values first.
entries.zh-Hans: 请先用有效值填写上面的字段。

entries.en: The Runtime cannot run this operation now; the reasons are shown above.
entries.zh-Hans: Runtime 当前无法运行此操作，原因见上方。

entries.en: A Job of this tab is running; wait for it or stop it first.
entries.zh-Hans: 此标签页有 Job 正在运行；请等待其结束或先停止它。
